text: Qedela isaga esikhuthaza abantu ukuthi basizane: “… ziyagezana.”
gloss: Complete the proverb urging people to help one another: '… wash each other.' — Hands: 'Izandla ziyagezana'.

text: Izinambuzane zinemilenze eyisithupha. Isicabucabu sona sinemilenze emingaki?
gloss: Insects have six legs. How many does a spider have? — 8: spiders are arachnids, not insects.

text: Leli dolobha libizwa ngokuthi yiGoli ngenxa yegolide elatholakala khona ngo-1886. Igama lalo elisemthethweni lithini?
gloss: This city is called eGoli because of the gold found there in 1886. What is its official name? — Johannesburg (Witwatersrand gold rush). Kimberley is the diamond trap.

text: Igama elithi “indlulamithi” lisho “edlula imithi”. Ngakho lesi silwane sidume ngani?
gloss: The word for giraffe, 'indlulamithi', means 'the one that passes (is taller than) the trees'. What is the animal known for? — Its height.

text: Uphuthu, oluvame ukudliwa namasi, lwenziwa ngani?
gloss: Uphuthu, often eaten with amasi (sour milk), is made from what? — Maize meal (crumbly maize porridge).

text: Ebholeni lezinyawo, uma unompempe ekhombisa umdlali ikhadi elibomvu, kusho ukuthini?
gloss: In football, when the referee shows a player a red card, what does it mean? — He is sent off. The team plays a man short (no replacement); a ten-minute sin bin is rugby.

text: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuba uMhlaba uzungeze iLanga kanye?
gloss: How long does the Earth take to go round the Sun once? — One year. 'One day' is the trap: that is one turn on its axis.

text: NgesiZulu “luhlaza” lungasho imibala emibili: okotshani noma okwesibhakabhaka. Uma uxuba upende ophuzi nopende oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, uthola umbala onjani?
gloss: In Zulu 'luhlaza' covers both grass-green and sky-blue. Mix yellow paint with sky-blue paint: what colour do you get? — Grass green.

text: Esibayeni kunezinkomo eziyisithupha, phakathi kwazo kuzulazula izinkukhu ezine. Imilenze yazo zonke ihlangene ingaki?
gloss: In the kraal there are six cows and four chickens wandering among them. How many legs altogether? — 32: 6×4 + 4×2. 40 is for those who give chickens four legs.

text: NgokweBhayibheli, uNowa wakha ini ukuze yena, umndeni wakhe nezilwane basinde kuzamcolo?
gloss: According to the Bible, what did Noah build so that he, his family and the animals survived the flood? — A ship (the ark). The tower is Babel's.

text: Ekuseni umi ubheke ngqo lapho ilanga liphuma khona. Isandla sakho sobunxele sikhomba ngakuphi?
gloss: In the morning you stand facing exactly where the sun rises. Which way does your left hand point? — North: facing east, left is north.

text: UPhuzekhemisi noMfaz' Omnyama baziwa kakhulu ngaluphi uhlobo lomculo?
gloss: Phuzekhemisi and Mfaz' Omnyama are best known for which kind of music? — Maskandi, the Zulu guitar-led genre.

text: Yimuphi umfula omkhulu kunayo yonke KwaZulu-Natali, oqala ezintabeni zoKhahlamba lapho wehla khona ngempophoma ende?
gloss: Which is the largest river in KwaZulu-Natal, rising in the Drakensberg where it drops down a tall waterfall? — The Tugela (uThukela) and the Tugela Falls.

text: Ubona umbani, bese ubala imizuzwana emithathu ngaphambi kokuzwa ukuduma kwezulu. Uma umsindo uhamba cishe amamitha angu-340 ngomzuzwana, umbani ukude kangakanani?
gloss: You see lightning and count three seconds before the thunder. If sound travels about 340 m a second, how far away is the lightning? — About 1 km (3 × 340 = 1,020 m).

text: Yini emzimbeni eyenza umchamo ngokuhlunga igazi?
gloss: What in the body makes urine by filtering the blood? — The kidneys. The bladder only stores urine; the liver does not make it.

text: Uma umuntu ethi “Akukho qili lazikhotha emhlane”, usho ukuthini?
gloss: 'No clever one ever licked his own back' means what? — However clever you are, you still need other people.

text: I-bunny chow, isidlo esadabuka eThekwini, iyini?
gloss: Bunny chow, a dish born in Durban, is what? — A part of a loaf hollowed and filled with curry.

text: Ekubaleni ngeminwe, u-6 ngesiZulu uthiwa “isithupha” ngoba kuphakanyiswa isithupha sesandla sesibili. Inombolo 7, “isikhombisa”, iqanjwe ngamuphi umunwe?
gloss: Counting on fingers, 6 is 'isithupha' (thumb) because the second hand's thumb goes up. Which finger is 7, 'isikhombisa', named after? — The index (pointing, -khomba) finger, the next one after the thumb.

text: NgoDisemba eNingizimu Afrika kusehlobo, amabhishi agcwele abantu. Ngaleso sikhathi eYurophu kuyisikhathi sini sonyaka?
gloss: In December it is summer in South Africa and the beaches are full. What season is it then in Europe? — Winter: the hemispheres have opposite seasons.

text: Umjaho we-Comrades ugijinywa phakathi kweTheku noMgungundlovu. Cishe ubude bawo bungamakhilomitha angaki?
gloss: The Comrades is run between Durban and Pietermaritzburg. Roughly how many kilometres is it? — About 90 (it varies around 86–90 km). 42 is the ordinary marathon trap.

text: Umkhosi woMhlanga, lapho izintombi ziletha imihlanga eNkosini yamaZulu, ubanjelwa esigodlweni saseNyokeni. Lesi sigodlo sikuphi?
gloss: The Reed Dance, where maidens bring reeds to the Zulu King, is held at Enyokeni palace. Where is it? — Nongoma.

text: ILadysmith Black Mambazo yaduma emhlabeni wonke ngemva kokucula ku-albhamu ethi “Graceland” (1986). Leyo albhamu ingekabani?
gloss: Ladysmith Black Mambazo became world famous after singing on the album 'Graceland' (1986). Whose album was it? — Paul Simon's. Belafonte worked with Miriam Makeba.

text: Ngokwenganekwane yesiZulu, uNkulunkulu wathuma unwabu ukuba lutshele abantu ukuthi ngeke bafe, kodwa lwabambezeleka endleleni. Yisiphi isilwane esafika kuqala nomlayezo wokufa?
gloss: In the Zulu tale, uNkulunkulu sent the chameleon to tell people they would not die, but it dawdled. Which animal arrived first with the message of death? — The lizard (intulo).

text: UMbusi waseNdiya uShah Jahan wakha i-Taj Mahal ukuze ibe yini?
gloss: Why did the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan build the Taj Mahal? — As a tomb for his wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

text: Emahhashini asolwandle, ngubani othwala amaqanda aze achamusele?
gloss: In seahorses, who carries the eggs until they hatch? — The male, in his brood pouch.

text: Ngubani owasungula umshini wokunyathelisa onezinhlamvu ezinyakazayo eYurophu ngekhulu le-15?
gloss: Who invented the movable-type printing press in Europe in the 15th century? — Johannes Gutenberg. The others are near-contemporaries.

text: Efilimini yopopayi ethi “The Lion King”, inkosana ibizwa ngokuthi nguSimba. NgesiSwahili leli gama lisho ukuthini?
gloss: In the cartoon 'The Lion King' the young prince is Simba. What does the name mean in Swahili? — Lion. The film's title is the clue; 'king' is the trap.

text: Amagama athi “itafula”, “ifasitela” nelithi “ibhulukwe” angena esiZulwini evela kuluphi ulimi?
gloss: The words 'itafula' (table), 'ifasitela' (window) and 'ibhulukwe' (trousers) came into Zulu from which language? — Afrikaans: tafel, venster, broek. English 'table, window, trousers' could not give these forms.

text: Umalume ngumfowabo kamama. Ngokwakheka kwegama, “ubabekazi” ungubani?
gloss: Umalume is mother's brother. From how the word is built, who is 'ubabekazi'? — Father's sister: baba (father) + -kazi (female).

text: INdebe yoMhlaba yeFIFA yabanjelwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-2010. Lowo nyaka ubhalwa kanjani ngezinombolo zamaRoma?
gloss: South Africa hosted the FIFA World Cup in 2010. How is that year written in Roman numerals? — MMX: M = 1000 twice, X = 10.

text: Uma sisola umuntu, sivame ukwenza umsindo othi “tsk-tsk” ngokuqhafaza ulimi emazinyweni angaphambili. EsiZulwini lowo msindo ubhalwa ngaluphi uhlamvu?
gloss: When we disapprove of someone we make a 'tsk-tsk' by clicking the tongue on the front teeth. Which Zulu letter writes that sound? — c, the dental click. q is alveolar, x lateral (the horse-urging click), gq voiced alveolar.

text: Esiqongweni sentaba, cishe amamitha angu-3000 ngaphezu kwezinga lolwandle, umoya uncane. Amanzi abila ezingeni lokushisa elingakanani lapho?
gloss: On a mountain top about 3,000 m above sea level the air is thin. At what temperature does water boil there? — About 90 °C: lower air pressure lowers the boiling point.

text: Ikhwezi, elikhanya kakhulu empumalanga ekuseni ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga, empeleni aliyona inkanyezi. Liyini?
gloss: Ikhwezi, the 'morning star' shining brightly in the east before sunrise, is not a star at all. What is it? — The planet Venus, the brightest object in the sky after the Sun and Moon.

text: Ngo-1996 e-Atlanta, uJosia Thugwane waba ngowokuqala waseNingizimu Afrika omnyama ukuwina indondo yegolide kuma-Olimpiki. Wayiwina kuwuphi umjaho?
gloss: In Atlanta 1996, Josia Thugwane became the first black South African to win Olympic gold. In which race? — The marathon.

text: Ifilimu yaseNingizimu Afrika eyawina i-Oscar yefilimu yolimi lwangaphandle ngo-2006 yayibizwa ngokuthi yini?
gloss: Which South African film won the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film in 2006? — Tsotsi. 'Yesterday' (in Zulu) was only nominated, in 2005; District 9 was nominated for Best Picture.

text: Enovelini kaChinua Achebe ethi “Things Fall Apart”, umlingiswa oyinhloko uOkonkwo ungowasiphi isizwe?
gloss: In Chinua Achebe's novel 'Things Fall Apart', which people does the hero Okonkwo belong to? — The Igbo.

text: Ikhodi ye-QR, esiyiskena ngomakhalekhukhwini, yasungulwa ngo-1994 ukuze kulandelelwe izingxenye zezimoto efekthri. Yasungulelwa kuliphi izwe?
gloss: The QR code we scan with our phones was invented in 1994 to track car parts in a factory. In which country? — Japan (Denso Wave, a Toyota group company).

text: ILesotho izungezwe nxazonke yiNingizimu Afrika kuphela. Yiliphi kulawa mazwe elizungezwe nxazonke yizwe elilodwa, njengayo?
gloss: Lesotho is entirely surrounded by South Africa alone. Which of these countries is likewise entirely surrounded by a single country? — San Marino (by Italy). Eswatini also borders Mozambique; Liechtenstein borders two countries.

text: Emaqandeni engwenya, yini enquma ukuthi kuzochamusela iduna noma insikazi?
gloss: In crocodile eggs, what decides whether a male or a female hatches? — The temperature of the nest.

text: Uma ilanga lisithekiswa yinyanga emini, ngalolo suku inyanga ikusiphi isigaba?
gloss: When the Moon eclipses the Sun, what phase is the Moon in that day? — New moon: it sits between Earth and Sun, its dark side to us. Full moon is when a lunar eclipse happens.

text: Igazi lethu libomvu ngenxa yensimbi (i-ayoni) eliyiphethe. Elembambazi lona liluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngoba esikhundleni sensimbi lisebenzisa yiphi into?
gloss: Our blood is red because of the iron it carries. An octopus's blood is blue because instead of iron it uses what? — Copper (haemocyanin).

text: Iqoqo lezinkanyezi elibizwa ngesiZulu ngokuthi yisiLimela, igama elihlobene no-“ukulima”, ngesiNgisi laziwa ngokuthi yini?
gloss: The star cluster called isiLimela in Zulu, a name linked to 'ukulima' (to plough), is known in English as what? — The Pleiades.

text: Iqoqo lezinkondlo elidumile elithi “Amal'eZulu” labhalwa ngubani?
gloss: Who wrote the famous poetry collection 'Amal'eZulu'? — B. W. Vilakazi. The others are fellow Zulu writers.

text: Ikhyubhu kaRubik, ithoyizi elixazululwa ngokusonta izinhlangothi zalo ezinemibala, yasungulwa ngo-1974 nguErnő Rubik. Yasungulelwa kuliphi izwe?
gloss: The Rubik's Cube, a toy solved by twisting its coloured faces, was invented in 1974 by Ernő Rubik. In which country? — Hungary.

text: Leli zwe libanzi ngokwanele ukuba nezikhathi ezihlukene ezinhlanu, kodwa ezweni lonke amawashi akhombisa isikhathi esisodwa. Yiliphi?
gloss: This country is wide enough for five time zones, yet all its clocks show one time. Which? — China (Beijing time). Russia, Australia and Brazil use several zones.

text: Itiye elimnyama netiye eliluhlaza okotshani kwenziwa ngamaqabunga esitshalo esifanayo. Umehluko wawo uvela kuphi ikakhulukazi?
gloss: Black and green tea come from the leaves of the same plant. Where does the difference mainly come from? — How the leaves are processed: black tea is oxidised, green is not.

text: Umuzi wobukhosi weNkosi uCetshwayo, owanika idolobha lanamuhla igama lawo, wawubizwa ngokuthi yini?
gloss: King Cetshwayo's royal homestead, which gave a modern town its name, was called what? — oNdini (Ulundi). KwaBulawayo and KwaDukuza were Shaka's, uMgungundlovu Dingane's.

text: Igama elithi “irobhothi” laqala ukusetshenziswa emdlalweni weshashalazi, livela egameni elisho “umsebenzi ophoqelelwe”. Lidabuka kuluphi ulimi?
gloss: The word 'robot' was first used in a stage play and comes from a word meaning 'forced labour'. From which language? — Czech: 'robota', in Karel Čapek's play R.U.R.

text: Ingilazi igcwele amanzi aze afika onqenqemeni, kuntanta kuwo amaqhwa. Uma onke amaqhwa encibilika, kwenzekani ngezinga lamanzi?
gloss: A glass is filled to the brim with water, ice floating in it. When all the ice melts, what happens to the water level? — It stays the same: floating ice displaces exactly its own weight of water, which is what it becomes when it melts.

text: NgoDisemba, emini enkulu yosuku olude kunazo zonke onyakeni, ilanga liba ngqo phezu kwekhanda emugqeni odlula esifundazweni saseLimpopo. Lowo mugqa ubizwa ngokuthi yini?
gloss: In December, at noon on the longest day of the year, the sun is straight overhead on a line that crosses Limpopo province. What is that line? — The Tropic of Capricorn, the southern tropic (near Polokwane).
